transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. I’ve been seeing and hearing things at work and at home that no one else seems to notice, and it’s starting to scare me. It has gotten to the point where I'm having a hard time telling what is actually real.
How long have you been experiencing these sights and sounds, and have you noticed any significant changes in your mood, such as feeling unusually depressed or manic, during this same time?

I've been hearing the whispers and seeing those shadowy figures for about ten months now. During this time, my mood has been swinging between flat, empty periods where I don't care about anything, and these highly wired, irritable phases where I feel completely amped up. The sights and sounds actually get much worse and more intense when I'm in those high-energy moods.

During the periods when you feel 'amped up' or flat, do these mood changes last for a significant portion of the total time you've been experiencing the hallucinations, or are they relatively brief compared to the overall ten months?

Yes, those amped-up periods have actually lasted for the vast majority of this past year. I've spent most of my time feeling completely revved up, with only very brief breaks or flatter periods in between. It definitely hasn't been a short phase; it's been going on like that almost constantly.
During those 'amped up' periods, did the hallucinations and delusions occur only during the times when your mood was elevated, or did they persist even when your mood was relatively stable?

They definitely get loudest when I'm amped up, but they also persisted during times when my mood felt completely stable. Earlier this year, there was a stretch of a few weeks where I felt pretty neutral and wasn't buzzing with energy, but I was still hearing the whispers and believing the emails were coded messages about me.
During that period of a few weeks when your mood felt stable, did you experience any symptoms of depression, such as feeling hopeless, losing interest in activities, or having trouble sleeping?

During that stretch, my mood felt pretty neutral and stable, so I didn't feel deeply depressed or hopeless. I did feel a bit flat and unmotivated—like just staring at my computer and skipping my art group—but it wasn't a major depressive crash. Even with my mood being neutral, I was still hearing the whispers and believing those company emails were coded messages about me.

Looking back over the entire ten-month period, have you experienced any episodes of significant depression or mania that lasted for at least two weeks at a time, or were the mood changes mostly related to your high-energy, 'amped up' states?

Looking back, my mood changes have been almost completely dominated by those high-energy, amped-up states, which have lasted for weeks and months at a time. I've spent the vast majority of the past year in that revved-up phase—barely sleeping and chasing grand plans—with only brief breaks or occasional flat periods in between. I haven't really had any major depressive crashes, just those constant highs and the occasional flat spell.

During those months when you were 'amped up,' did you experience a persistent period of at least one week where you needed very little sleep, felt unusually energetic, and engaged in risky or highly impulsive activities?

Yes, those periods lasted much longer than a week and would go on for months at a time. I’d regularly go two or three nights sleeping only a couple of hours but still wake up feeling completely charged and wired. While I didn't do anything wild or dangerous, my impulsivity showed up as staying up all night pacing, starting massive spreadsheets, and obsessively trying to rewrite company policies without ever finishing them.
Over the entire ten-month period, were there any stretches of at least two weeks where you experienced the hallucinations and delusions without any significant mood symptoms present?

Yes, earlier this year there was a stretch of a few weeks where my mood felt completely neutral and stable, with no big highs or crashes. Even though I didn't have that buzzing energy, I was still hearing the whispers and remained convinced that the company emails were coded messages about me.

During that multi-week period where your mood was stable and you were not feeling 'amped up,' did you experience any significant functional impairment, such as difficulty maintaining your job responsibilities or managing your daily self-care?

Yes, even when my mood was stable, the whispers and my belief about the coded emails made it impossible to focus, causing me to miss deadlines and lose projects. It got to the point where my wife had to step in to manage our household bills and daily responsibilities because I couldn't keep things straight. Those experiences alone were enough to severely disrupt my ability to function, even without the high energy.

To clarify, did you experience these psychotic symptoms (the whispers and the belief about coded emails) for at least two weeks in the absence of any prominent mood symptoms, like the high energy or the flat spells, at any other point during these ten months?

No, it was primarily during that one stretch of a few weeks earlier this year where my mood felt completely neutral. Even though I wasn't experiencing the highs or the flat spells then, the whispers and the belief about the coded emails were still happening every day.
Did you experience any period of at least two weeks where you had the whispers and the belief about the emails while your mood was stable, prior to the onset of the high-energy states you described?

Yes, there was indeed a stretch of a few weeks earlier this year where my mood was completely neutral and I had no high-energy spells or crashes. Even though I wasn't experiencing those buzzing manic states, I was still hearing the whispers and remained convinced the emails were coded messages about me. That lasted for at least two weeks during that stable period.
Looking back at the very beginning of these ten months, did the hallucinations and delusions start before you ever experienced any of these 'amped up' or high-energy mood episodes?

Actually, looking back, the high-energy "amped up" periods started first, about a year ago, while the whispering and shadowy figures didn't become a steady presence until about ten months ago. Both have been building up since the reorganization fifteen months ago, but the mood swings definitely seemed to happen before the hallucinations and delusions.
